local_arm_scope: Local runtime profile only, usable before either Python script and its declared flags; no census-suite outcome or portable-platform qualification is asserted here.

generated_execution_envelope.scope: The execution owner must bind and enforce the admitted source-control envelope; declaration is not a hard OS RSS certificate.

portability_prerequisite: Construct a fresh plan for relocated exact sources, runtime descriptors and a fresh owned evidence directory. The private construction PLAN is excluded. The selected source-test pool or CI runner must enforce wall180s and declare1GiB; the helper is not a scheduler. New runtime compatibility is established only by its own generated-test outcome, with no portable ABI claim.

plan_constructor.pure_API: build_plan(core_source, wrapper_source, range_source, original_root, operation_profiles, evidence_root, worker_source) -> dict
plan_constructor.CLI_output: Writes exactly the fresh PLAN JSON and prints its SHA256 only; never executes the worker.
